data.name: Faelynn

weaponImprint.name: Bristlefang Beast
weaponImprint.trait: AoE damage dealt is increased by 5%. When dealing AoE Corrosion damage, the AoE damage dealt is further increase by 5%.
weaponImprint.effect:
If the active skill does not deal damage, Corrosion damage is increased by 20%/24%/28%/32%/36%/40% for 3 turns.

For each active skill attacks, Corrosion damage is increased by 5%/8%/11%/14%/17%/20%, up to a maximum of 15%/24%/33%/42%/51%/60%, for 1 turn.

After each attack in the current round, the damage of the next skill is increased by 4%, up to a maximum of 16%.
weaponImprint.imprintDescription: Damage dealt to targets with Corrosion debuffs is increased by 2.5%. Increase damage dealt to Paradeus by 2.5%.

data.effects:
Faelynn's memories were filled with painful and repressed secrets, yet a glimmer of light still shone through her mind, like the warm sunshine illuminating every dark cloud.
"Master, no matter how long you're gone, I... I'll always wait patiently for you to come home!"

level1.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to it.

At the start of battle, Faelynn gains 1 stack of [effect:8931be12-0b6a-491e-ad72-c9699701433b], stacking up to 3 times. Faelynn gains 1 stack of [effect:8931be12-0b6a-491e-ad72-c9699701433b] for each active skill used (excluding [effect:288d4b5f-1963-4b20-8e23-e9ec4f9956be]).

At the start of the turn, if Faelynn is on a phase tile, she gains 1 point of mobility and 1 stack of [effect:d49289da-ffc9-4459-80ca-48d6948203bd] for each tile level for 1 turn.

If Faelynn takes damage on a Corrosion tile, transfers 50% of the initial damage taken to the ally unit with the highest current HP (excluding Faelynn herself).

Faelynn is immune to displacement, movement debuffs. and command prohibition effects.
